narr: A cold pool aloft and surface front caused a round of strong to severe storms over all of southern New England. Hail from 1 to 2 inches fell in MA, RI, and CT while localized flash flooding was observed in southern RI and MA.
ev: In Warwick, multiple cars were struck in street flooding.
In Warwick, a car was stuck in street flooding.
In Charlestown, roads were closed due to flooding.
